data.name: Bhabhor
data.gender_notes: Bhabhor is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to Lord Vishnu. Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘bhaj’ (to serve or adore) and ‘bhagavan’ (Lord). The name Bhabhor carries the meaning “Lord Vishnu's devotee” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhabhor usually hope their child will grow to embody lord vishnu's devotee and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion, faith, and surrender to the divine.
data.etymology: Bhabhor belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Vishnu's devotee.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhabhor total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
